name: Nioka Mako
source:
[A modest club member with a reserved attitude and outstanding discipline]

A kind and friendly girl. Although she looks plain, she has a very observant personality and is happy to act as a manager within the club. 

She is friendly and gets along well with Aika, who is in the same class (on the other hand, she doesn't get along well with Maika). She admires Miki and seems to be fond of her, at least for now...

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara09.html]official site[/url]]
